44900.commentary: (MNt) pavadanti etehī'ti pavādā, diṭṭhigatikānaṃ nānādiṭṭhidīpakā samayā'ti āha cattāro sassatavādā'tiādi.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañ'c'eva āyatiñ'ca sukhavipākaṃ tadaññe puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇaparappavāde abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate cā'ti.

44901.commentary: (DNa) samayaṃ pavadanti etthā'ti samayappavādako, tasmiṃ kira ṭhāne caṅkī-tārukkha-pokkharasāti-ppabhutayo brāhmaṇā nigaṇṭha-acelaka-paribbājak'ādayo ca pabbajitā sannipatitvā attano attano samayaṃ vadanti kathenti dīpenti, tasmā so ārāmo samayappavādako'ti vuccati. (MNa) bhassappavādako'ti bhassaṃ vuccati kathāmaggo, taṃ pavadati kathetī'ti bhassappavādako.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena poṭṭhapādo paribbājako samayappavādake tinduk'ācīre ekasālake mallikāya ārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ tiṃsamattehi paribbājakasatehi.
disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ, bhante, saccako nigaṇṭhaputto āgacchati bhassappavādako paṇḍitavādo sādhusammato bahujanassa.

44902.meaning1: who asserts; who insists; who propounds; who proclaims
44902.commentary: (NIDD1) pavādiyāse'ti vippavadantī'ti'pi pavādiyāse. atha vā sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ pavadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharanti. (SNPa) pavādiyāse'ti vādino.

examples.text: kasmā nu saccāni vadanti nānā, pavādiyāse kusalā vadānā, saccāni sutāni bahūni nānā, udāhu te takkam'anussaranti.

44905.commentary: (DHPa) sabbā disā sappuriso pavāyati yasmā pana sappuriso sīlagandhena sabbā'pi disā ajjhottharitvā'va gacchati, tasmā tassa gandho na paṭivātam'etī'ti na vattabbo. tena vuttaṃ paṭivātam'etī'ti.

examples.text: na pupphagandho paṭivātam'eti, na candanaṃ tagaramallikā, satañ'ca gandho paṭivātam'eti, sabbā disā sappuriso pavāyati.
sabbasaṃhārako n'atthi, suddhaṃ kaṅgu pavāyati, alikaṃ bhāyatiyaṃ dhuttī, saccam'āha mahallikā'ti.
dibbagandhaṃ pavāyantaṃ, yo me pupphagghiyaṃ adā, tam'ahaṃ kittayissāmi, suṇātha mama bhāsato.

44908.commentary: (VINa) suppavāyitan'ti suṭṭhu pavāyitaṃ sabbaṭṭhānesu samaṃ katvā tante pasāritaṃ.

examples.text: idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ'ca karotha, vitthatañ'ca, appitañ'ca, suvītañ'ca, suppavāyitañ'ca, suvilekhitañ'ca, suvitacchitañ'ca karotha

44911.commentary: (VMVt) uposathaṃ, pavāraṇaṃ vā saṅghe kātuṃ adān'atthāya āpattiyā codayato adhippāyo uposatha-pavāraṇaṭṭhapan'ādhippāyo

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, atthavase paṭicca tathāgatena sāvakānaṃ pātimokkhaṃ paññattaṃ… pātimokkh'uddeso paññatto… pātimokkhaṭṭhapanaṃ paññattaṃ… pavāraṇā paññattā… pavāraṇaṭṭhapanaṃ paññattaṃ… tajjanīyakammaṃ paññattaṃ… niyassakammaṃ paññattaṃ…

44912.meaning1: agreement about (the postponement of) the invitation ceremony
44912.commentary: (MNa) pavāraṇasaṅgaho nāma ñattidutiyena kammena diyyati kassa pan'esa diyyati, kassa na diyyatī'ti. akārakassa tāva bālaputhujjanassa na diyyati, tathā āraddhavipassakassa c'eva ariyasāvakassa ca. yassa pana samatho vā taruṇo hoti vipassanā vā, tassa diyyati. bhagavā'pi tadā bhikkhūnaṃ citt'ācāraṃ parivīmaṃsanto samathavipassanānaṃ taruṇabhāvaṃ ñatvā, mayi ajja pavārente disāsu vassaṃvuṭṭhā bhikkhū idha osarissanti. tato ime bhikkhū vuḍḍhatarehi bhikkhūhi sen'āsane gahite visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ na sakkhissanti. sace'pi cārikaṃ pakkamissāmi, imesaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ dullabham'eva bhavissati. mayi pana apavārente bhikkhū'pi imaṃ sāvatthiṃ na osarissanti, aham'pi cārikaṃ na pakkamissāmi, evaṃ imesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ apalibuddhaṃ bhavissati. te attano attano vasanaṭṭhāne phāsu viharantā samathavipassanā thāmajātā katvā visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ sakkhissantī'ti so taṃdivasaṃ apavāretvā kattikapuṇṇamāyaṃ pavāressāmī'ti bhikkhūnaṃ pavāraṇasaṅgahaṃ anujāni. pavāraṇasaṅgahasmiñ'hi laddhe yassa nissayapaṭipannassa ācariy'upajjhāyā pakkamanti, so'pi sace patirūpo nissayadāyako āgamissati, tassa santike nissayaṃ gaṇhissāmī'ti yāva gimhānaṃ pacchimamāsā vasituṃ labhati. sace'pi saṭṭhivassā bhikkhū āgacchanti, tassa sen'āsanaṃ gahetuṃ na labhanti. ayañ'ca pana pavāraṇasaṅgaho ekassa dinno'pi sabbesaṃ dinno'y'eva hoti.

examples.text: yassa kho pana samatho vā vipassanā vā taruṇo hoti, ayaṃ imaṃ parihāraṃ labhati, pavāraṇasaṅgaho'pi etass'eva anuññāto.
agilānena bhikkhunā catumāsappaccayapavāraṇā sāditabbā aññatra punapavāraṇāya, aññatra niccapavāraṇāya. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

44914.meaning1: (vinaya) invitation ceremony at the end of the rains retreat

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe pannarase pavāraṇāya puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.
saṃvaseyya vā'ti ukkhittakena saddhiṃ uposathaṃ vā pavāraṇaṃ vā saṅghakammaṃ vā karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
gihisamārambho nāma ñātakā vā honti pavāritā vā pakatipaṭiyattaṃ vā.
anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, rasarase, ñātakānaṃ pavāritānaṃ, aññass'atthāya, attano dhanena, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

44919.meaning1: satisfied; fulfilled; who has refused more
44919.commentary: (VIN 2.5.4.5) pavārito nāma asanaṃ paññāyati, bhojanaṃ paññāyati, hatthapāse ṭhito abhiharati, paṭikkhepo paññāyati.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhuttāvī pavārito anatirittaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
idh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, bhuttāvī assaṃ pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāva'd'attho, siyā ca me piṇḍapāto atirekadhammo chaḍḍanīyadhammo
appavārite pavāritasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. appavārite vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. appavārite appavāritasaññī, anāpatti.

44923.meaning1: (vinaya) to be invited; to be requested; should ask for criticism (wrt)
44923.meaning2: (vinaya) to be invited; to be requested

examples.text: vassaṃ vuṭṭhāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṅghe tīhi ṭhānehi pavāretabbaṃ diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā, ayam'pi dhammo
pavāreti ce'pi, āvuso, bhikkhu, vadantu maṃ āyasmanto, vacanīyo'mhi āyasmantehī'ti, so ca hoti dubbaco, dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato, akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ
saṅghaṃ, bhante, pavāremi diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā. vadantu maṃ āyasmanto anukampaṃ upādāya. passanto paṭikarissāmi
tañ'ce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
bhesajjapariyantā nāma bhesajjāni pariggahitāni honti, ettakehi bhesajjehi pavāremī'ti. rattipariyantā nāma rattiyo pariggahitāyo honti, ettakāsu rattīsu pavāremī'ti.

44928.meaning2: having invited, having satisfied, having given in charge

44929.meaning2: invited, satisfied, gave in charge, celebrated the Pavāraṇa

examples.text: ratanaṃ nāma muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavālaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohit'aṅko masāragallaṃ.
accekacīvaraṃ nāma senāya vā gantu'kāmo hoti, pavāsaṃ vā gantu'kāmo hoti, gilāno vā hoti, gabbhinī vā hoti, assaddhassa vā saddhā uppannā hoti, appasannassa vā pasādo uppanno hoti

44932.meaning1: who lives abroad; who lives away from home
44932.meaning2: who lives abroad or away from home

examples.text: cirappavāsiṃ purisaṃ, dūrato sotthim'āgataṃ, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, abhinandanti āgataṃ.
dhammappati hi so seṭṭho, visadosappavāhako, gambhīre patitassa me, thalaṃ pāṇiñ'ca dassaye.

44935.meaning1: causing to be carried away (in); causing to be washed away

examples.text: tesu ussukkajātesu, bhavasot'ānusārisu, ke'dha taṇhaṃ pavāhiṃsu, ke lokasmiṃ anussukā'ti.

44938.meaning2: made to flow, caused to be carried away, removed

44940.meaning1: causes to be removed; makes carry away (from); washes away
44940.meaning2: makes to flow, causes to be carried away, removes

examples.text: so taṃ vīṇaṃ… sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā agginā ḍaheyya, agginā ḍahitvā masiṃ kareyya. masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā ophuneyya, nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya.
mokkhasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, puññasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, bāhukāya pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakammaṃ kataṃ pavāhetī'ti.

44941.meaning2: makes to flow, causes to be carried away, removes

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, puriso muñjamhā īsikaṃ pavāheyya. tassa evam'assa ayaṃ muñjo, ayaṃ īsikā, añño muñjo, aññā īsikā, muñjamhā tv'eva īsikā pavāḷhā'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assalāyana, brāhmaṇo'va nu kho pahoti sottisināniṃ ādāya nadiṃ gantvā rajojallaṃ pavāhetuṃ, no khattiyo, no vesso, no suddo'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama!

44943.meaning1: having removed (something from); having rinsed off; having washed away
44943.meaning2: having made to flow, having caused to be carried away, having removed

examples.text: idāni te, bhante, taṃ rajojallaṃ pavāhetvā sunhātā suvilittā kappitakesamassū odātavatthā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāressantī'ti.

44944.meaning2: made to flow, caused to be carried away, removed

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano. tatr'imāni ratanāni, seyyath'idaṃ muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohit'aṅgo masāragallaṃ
seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, puriso muñjamhā īsikaṃ pavāheyya. tassa evam'assa ayaṃ muñjo, ayaṃ īsikā, añño muñjo, aññā īsikā, muñjamhā tv'eva īsikā pavāḷhā'ti.

44950.meaning1: makes an investigation; examines; makes a test
44950.commentary: (MNa) pavicinatī'ti anicc'ādi-vasena pavicinati. itaraṃ padadvayaṃ etass'eva vevacanaṃ.

examples.text: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicayati parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjati, dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti

44951.meaning1: making an investigation; examines; making a test

examples.text: tassa taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinato pavicayato parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti vīriyaṃ asallīnaṃ.

44952.synonym: upaparikkhati, upavicarati, tīreti, paṭivicarati, pavicinati, vicāreti, vicināti, vīmaṃsati, samannesati, samanvesati

examples.text: so tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsam'āpajjati.

44953.meaning2: examining; investigating; considering carefully; lit. moving around
44953.synonym: upaparikkhanta, pavicinanta, vicinanta, vīmaṃsamāna, samannesanta, samannesamāna, samanvesanta

examples.text: tassa taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinato pavicarato parivīmaṃsam'āpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti vīriyaṃ asallīnaṃ

44954.synonym: upaparikkhati, upavicarati, tīreti, paṭivicarati, pavicarati, vicāreti, vicinati, vicināti, vīmaṃsati, samannesati, samanvesati
44954.commentary: (MNa) pavicinatī'ti anicc'ādi-vasena pavicinati. itaraṃ padadvayaṃ etass'eva vevacanaṃ.

examples.text: so tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsam'āpajjati.

44955.synonym: upaparikkhanta, vicinanta, vīmaṃsamāna, samannesanta, samannesamāna, samanvesanta

examples.text: tassa taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinato pavicayato parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti vīriyaṃ asallīnaṃ.

44958.meaning1: should be thrown; should be shot

examples.text: suññ'āgāraṃ paviṭṭhassa, santacittassa bhikkhuno, amānusī rati hoti, sammā dhammaṃ vipassato.
idaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā, vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā, uṭṭhāy'āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho

44961.notes: Theragāthā verse 87 (TH1.87, TH87) is attributed to him.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā musilo tuṇhī ahosi. atha kho āyasmā nārado āyasmantaṃ paviṭṭhaṃ etadavoca, sādh'āvuso paviṭṭha, ahaṃ etaṃ pañhaṃ labheyyaṃ. maṃ etaṃ pañhaṃ puccha.

44964.meaning1: we have entered; we have gone (into)

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhagavā bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ etadavoca, akālo kho tāva, bāhiya, antaragharaṃ paviṭṭh'amhā piṇḍāyā'ti.

44965.commentary: (NIDD1) pavitakkam'āgamā'ti takkento vitakkento saṅkappento jayo nu kho me bhavissati, parājayo nu kho me bhavissati, kathaṃ niggahaṃ karissāmi, kathaṃ paṭikammaṃ karissāmi, kathaṃ visesaṃ karissāmi, kathaṃ paṭivisesaṃ karissāmi, kathaṃ āveṭhiyaṃ karissāmi, kathaṃ nibbeṭhiyaṃ karissāmi, kathaṃ chedaṃ karissāmi, kathaṃ maṇḍalaṃ karissāmi, evaṃ takkento vitakkento saṅkappento āgato'si upagato'si sampatto'si mayā saddhiṃ samāgato'sī'ti, atha tvaṃ pavitakkam'āgamā. (SNPa) pavitakkan'ti jayo nu kho me bhavissatī'ti ādīni vitakkento.

examples.text: atha tvaṃ pavitakkam'āgamā, manasā diṭṭhigatāni cintayanto, dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātave'ti.

44967.commentary: (SNa) bhāgaso pavibhajan'ti satipaṭṭhān'ādikoṭṭhāsavasena dhammaṃ vibhajantaṃ. pavibhajjā'ti vā pāṭho, aṅgapaccaṅgakoṭṭhāsavasena vibhajitvā vibhajitvā passathā'ti attho.

examples.text: ummaggapathaṃ mārassa abhibhuyya, carati pabhijja khilāni, taṃ passatha bandhapamuñcakaraṃ, asitaṃ bhāgaso pavibhajaṃ.
esā antaradhāyāmi, kucchiṃ vā pavisāmi te, pakhum'antarikāyam'pi, tiṭṭhantiṃ maṃ na dakkhasi.
so eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati eko paṭikkamati eko raho nisīdati eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
so antaragharaṃ pavisanto na kāyaṃ unnāmeti, na kāyaṃ onāmeti, na kāyaṃ sannāmeti, na kāyaṃ vināmeti.
tattha cakkhumā puriso majjhe ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisante'pi nikkhamante'pi
dhātiyo ayyaputto ekako'ti vegena sāṇiṃ ukkhipitvā anto pavisamānā bodhisattaṃ sayane pallaṅkena nisinnaṃ tañ'ca pāṭihāriyaṃ disvā gantvā rañño ārocayiṃsu
atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu.
addasaṃsu kho sakkassa devānam'indassa paricārikāyo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ, disvā ottappamānā hirīyamānā sakaṃ sakaṃ ovarakaṃ pavisiṃsu.

44974.meaning1: should be entered; should be gone into
44974.commentary: (MNa) n'ātikālenā'ti na atipāto pavisitabbaṃ, na atidivā paṭikkamitabbaṃ, bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ'y'eva pavisitabbañ'ca nikkhamitabbañ'ca. atipāto pavisitvā atidivā nikkhamantassa hi cetiy'aṅgaṇa-bodhiy'aṅgaṇa-vatt'ādīni parihāyanti. kālass'eva mukhaṃ dhovitvā makkaṭakasuttāni chindantena ussāvabindū nipātentena gāmaṃ pavisitvā yāguṃ pariyesitvā yāva bhikkhākālā antogāme'y'eva nānappakāraṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentena nisīditvā bhattakiccaṃ katvā divā nikkhamma bhikkhūnaṃ pādadhovanavelāya vihāraṃ paccāgantabbaṃ hoti.

examples.text: āraññiken'āvuso, bhikkhunā saṅghagatena saṅghe viharantena n'ātikālena gāmo pavisitabbo n'ātidivā paṭikkamitabbaṃ.

44975.meaning1: wanting to enter; wanting to go (somewhere for)

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ sunivattho hoti pattacīvaram'ādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pavisitu'kāmo.

44976.meaning1: fact of wanting to enter; fact of wanting to go (into)

examples.text: te māsam'pi dvemāsam'pi na labhanti gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisituṃ
santaṃ nāma bhikkhuṃ sakkā hoti āpucchā pavisituṃ. asantaṃ nāma bhikkhuṃ na sakkā hoti āpucchā pavisituṃ.
atha kho bāhiyo dārucīriyo taramānarūpo jetavanā nikkhamitvā sāvatthiṃ pavisitvā addasa bhagavantaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ
atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro, tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno āḷindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi. vivari bhagavā dvāraṃ.
na antalikkhe na samuddamajjhe, na pabbatānaṃ vivaraṃ pavissa, na vijjatī so jagatippadeso, yatthaṭṭhito mucceyya pāpakammā.

44980.commentary: (SNa) pavivitto'ti kāyaviveko ca vivekaṭṭhakāyānaṃ nekkhamm'ābhiratānaṃ, cittaviveko ca parisuddhacittānaṃ paramavodānappattānaṃ, upadhiviveko ca nirupadhīnaṃ puggalānaṃ visaṅkhāragatānan'ti, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ vivekānaṃ lābhī.

examples.text: pavivittassa-ayaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo saṅgaṇik'ārāmassa
nibbedhikapañño, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. app'iccho, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. santuṭṭho, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. pavivitto, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. asaṃsaṭṭho, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto.

44982.meaning1: living in seclusion; remaining in solitude

examples.text: yassu maññāmi samaṇe, pavivittavihārino, sambuddhā iti maññāno, gacchāmi te upāsituṃ.
pavivekarasaṃ pitvā, rasaṃ upasamassa ca, niddaro hoti nippāpo, dhammapītirasaṃ pivaṃ.
saṅgaṇikāya saṃvattanti no pavivekāya

44984.commentary: (ITIa) pavivekavitakko pana phalasamāpattiyā pubbaṅ'gamo sampayutto ca, dibbavihār'ādivasenā'pi labbhat'eva.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kin'ti mayaṃ kālena kālaṃ pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja vihareyyāmā'ti! evañ'hi vo, gahapati, sikkhitabban'ti.
tathāgataṃ, bhikkhave, arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ dve vitakkā bahulaṃ samudācaranti khemo ca vitakko, paviveko ca.

44985.meaning1: talk on solitude; discussion about seclusion

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca pavivitto pavivekakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

appicchakathā, santuṭṭhikathā, pavivekakathā, asaṃsaggakathā, vīriy'ārambhakathā, sīlakathā, samādhikathā, paññākathā, vimuttikathā, vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā'ti, imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa kathāvatthūni.
pavivek'ārāmo, bhikkhave, tathāgato pavivekarato. tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ pavivek'ārāmaṃ pavivekarataṃ es'eva vitakko bahulaṃ samudācarati, yaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ pahīnan'ti.

44987.meaning1: flavour of solitude; nectar of seclusion

examples.text: pavivekarasaṃ pitvā, rasaṃ upasamassa ca, niddaro hoti nippāpo, dhammapītirasaṃ pivaṃ.

44988.meaning1: pleasure of solitude; happiness of being alone

examples.text: idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ. āsevitabbaṃ, bhāvetabbaṃ, bahulīkātabbaṃ, na bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā'ti, vadāmi.

yo kho, nāgita, na'y'imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā'ti.

44989.meaning1: offering the pleasure of solitude; giving the happiness of being alone

44991.meaning1: habituated to seclusion; established in solitude; firmly entrenched in solitude
44991.commentary: (ANa) nekkhamm'ādhimutto'ti'ādi sabbaṃ arahattavasen'eva vuttaṃ. arahattañ'hi sabbakilesehi nikkhantattā nekkhammaṃ, teh'eva pavivittattā paviveko

examples.text: so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti, nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti, pavivek'ādhimutto hoti, abyāpajj'ādhimutto hoti, taṇhākkhay'ādhimutto hoti, upādānakkhay'ādhimutto hoti, asammoh'ādhimutto hoti.

44992.meaning1: enjoying solitude; taking pleasure in seclusion

examples.text: dasa'y'ime, bhikkhave, kaṇṭakā. katame dasa? pavivek'ārāmassa saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā kaṇṭako, asubhanimitt'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa subhanimitt'ānuyogo kaṇṭako
pavivek'ārāmo, bhikkhave, tathāgato pavivekarato. tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ pavivek'ārāmaṃ pavivekarataṃ es'eva vitakko bahulaṃ samudācarati, yaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ pahīnan'ti.

44993.meaning1: weapon of solitude; sword of seclusion
44993.commentary: (DNa) pavivek'āvudhan'ti kāyaviveko cittaviveko upadhiviveko'ti ayaṃ tividho'pi viveko'va āvudhaṃ. tassa nānākaraṇaṃ kāyaviveko vivekaṭṭhakāyānaṃ nekkhamm'ābhiratānaṃ. cittaviveko ca parisuddhacittānaṃ paramavodānappattānaṃ. upadhiviveko ca nirupadhīnaṃ puggalānaṃ.

examples.text: tīṇ'āvudhāni, sut'āvudhaṃ, pavivek'āvudhaṃ, paññ'āvudhaṃ.

44994.meaning1: state of solitude; life of seclusion
44994.construction:
pa + vi + √vic > vec > vek + *a + iya
paviveka + iya

examples.text: tapojigucchāya āyuttā, pālayaṃ pavivekiyaṃ, rūpe ca ye niviṭṭhāse, devalok'ābhinandino, te ve samm'ānusāsanti, paralokāya mātiyā'ti.

44996.meaning1: is called; is named; is said to be

examples.text: diṭṭhe dhamme ca yo attho, yo c'attho samparāyiko, atth'ābhisamayā dhīro, paṇḍito'ti pavuccatī'ti.
yo ca sameti pāpāni, aṇuṃ thūlāni sabbaso, samitattā hi pāpānaṃ, samaṇo'ti pavuccati.

satta devā, satta mānusā, satta pesācā, satta sarā, satta pavuṭā, satta papātā, satta papātasatāni, satta supinā, satta supinasatāni, cullāsīti mahākappino satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti.

44998.meaning1: one hundred winds; (comm) one hundred knots

examples.text: satta devā satta mānusā satta pisācā satta sarā satta pavuṭā satta pavuṭasatāni satta papātā satta papātasatāni satta supinā satta supinasatāni cullāsīti mahākappino satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti.

44999.meaning1: lived abroad; stayed away from home; resided overseas
44999.meaning2: dwelt abroad, was away from home

examples.text: pañcavīsāya khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī paduṭṭhā veditabbā bhavati. sāmikassa pavāsaṃ vaṇṇeti, pavuṭṭhaṃ na sarati, āgataṃ n'ābhinandati, avaṇṇaṃ tassa bhaṇati, vaṇṇaṃ tassa na bhaṇati, anatthaṃ tassa carati, atthaṃ tassa na carati
